TOP RIGHT: a few piped dollops of ivory Madagascar vanilla whipped ganache, no biscuit. MIDDLE LEFT: a small cluster of fresh strawberry halves, raspberries, blueberries and blackberries. MIDDLE RIGHT: two small artisan pink and ivory macarons matching reference. BOTTOM LEFT: a small cluster of edible pink and yellow flowers with tiny gold decorative flakes. BOTTOM RIGHT completely empty. No meringue, extra ingredients or text. Photorealistic independent product cutouts, no backgrounds, checkerboards, grid lines, labels, lettering, cast shadows outside objects, plates or utensils unless explicitly specified. This is an asset sheet to be cropped into ingredients for an interactive website, not a finished diagram.
